refnamediv.refpurpose: Structure of function pointers for a SilikoFunction object

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: A SilikoFunctionVTable is one of two components used to construct a SilikoFunction. The SilikoFunctionVTable is a table of functions used to interact with the other component, a void pointer to a user-defined state object for the function. If a function is a pure function, its implementation can be passed to SilikoPureFunctionCreate to construct a SilikoFunction object without using a bespoke SilikoFunctionVTable.
The call pointer points to a function that invokes the function’s implementation and returns the result.

The destroy pointer points to a function that takes the state object, and frees up any resources used by the state object. The function must also take care of dealocating the state object itself if applicable.
